senses.def: a thermoplastic polyamide; a family of strong resilient synthetic fibers
a group of synthetic fabrics, known generically as aliphatic polyamides
women's stockings made from a sheer material (nylon or rayon or silk)
(classical mythology) a minor nature goddess usually depicted as a beautiful maiden
ex: the ancient Greeks believed that nymphs inhabited forests and bodies of water
